# Variable `QB_GRAPHICS`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

When using `runqemu`, the QB_GRAPHICS variable controls the QEMU video card type to emulate. For example: `-vga std`.

This value is appended to the argument list when running `qemu`.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-QB_GRAPHICS
